subject: Execution
notes: LANDED kb/Work PB1123 (the ODO-refmod arm). A reference modifier whose position carries a function activation has that activation hoisted ahead of the statement as a PRE-op, so the occurs-depending group's length used to be read after it ran. ReferenceResolver.Resolve now marks PendingPreOps before the reference modifier is read and, when the modifier registered pre-ops over an OdoGroupPlace, the FreezeOdoExtent hook (StatementBinder.FreezeOdoExtentBeforeRefMod) inserts a copy of the DEPENDING ON object into a compiler temp AHEAD of them and repoints the group's extent at the temp, so step 6 (length) is evaluated in full before step 7 (reference modification): G(FUNCTION SETN(9):) with N = 5 is 5 positions.
